title: Agreement below an endpoint
statement: Let $n,k,e$ be natural numbers, let $A$ be an $n$-by-$k$ matrix of integers, and let $\mu,\mu' : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Z}$. Suppose that $\mu(a+ik+j)=A_{ij}$ for every $i<n$ and $j<k$, that $\mu'(x)=\mu(x)$ for every $x<e$, and that $a+nk\le e$. Then $\mu'(a+ik+j)=A_{ij}$ for every $i<n$ and $j<k$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is an integer matrix indexed by $i<n$ and $j<k$
